outcome: Infant Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity
Infant protective antibodies to Hepatitis B surface antigen
cohort: The study included 55 children born to mothers with chronic hepatitis B infection at a single hospital between January 1, 2013, and January 1, 2019.
finding: Two out of 55 infants who received three doses of hepatitis B vaccine tested positive for Hepatitis B surface antigen, and 78.2% of the cohort developed protective antibodies.
